## Summary
System running stable with **~9 hours remaining**. Champion holds position after 364 iterations.

## Key Metrics Comparison

| Metric | Champion | Last PASS |
|--------|----------|-----------|
| Tuning Mean | **1.904** | 1.762 |
| Tuning Min | **0.431** | 0.051 ⚠️ |
| Lockbox Mean | 1.793 | 1.793 |
| Lockbox Min | 1.134 | **1.347** |
| Worst MDD | **-9.3%** | -11.2% |

## Assessment

**Champion holds** — Last PASS candidate shows:
- ✅ Better lockbox minimum (more consistent OOS)
- ⚠️ Concerning tuning minimum (0.05 = near-zero fold)
- ❌ Worse drawdown profile (-11.2% vs -9.3%)

The `exp_macro_alpha_shadow` variant improved lockbox consistency but introduced fragility in tuning folds.

## Recommended Actions

```bash
# Execute next iteration
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

## Notes for Next Session
- Monitor tuning_min metric — candidates with <0.1 indicate fold instability
- Champion's fold14_mdd equals worst_mdd (single weak fold) — potential improvement target
- ~9 hours runway allows ~50-80 more iterations at current pace
